# Mimir — Find the Worthy

Mimir is an evidence-based AI CV evaluator for recruiters. It compares CV evidence with job-description requirements using document intelligence, claim entailment, evidence boundaries, Odin adversarial verification and deterministic JavaScript scoring. The AI model interprets evidence; it does not directly choose the numerical candidate score. Recruiters remain responsible for final decisions.

Canonical site: https://mimir.co.in/
